verdicts.reason: A turns the photo into an inset card with roughly even margins on the top, right and bottom, so it looks deliberate, and the left column keeps its hierarchy. Its flaws are a large empty band under the CTA and a logo that sits much closer to the top edge than the CTA does to the bottom. B insets the photo at the top and bottom but lets it bleed off the right edge, which looks like accidental letterboxing. Its logo and SAVE 15% badge also drift down unevenly, leaving the left column's spacing just as unbalanced as A's.
